title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.10.7
body_markdown:
*released September 10th, 2024*

### What's New in this Release

* Xamarin Profiler has been deprecated and removed from Visual Studio.
* Fixed a bug where certain UI components were showing up as larger than the rest of VS.
* Fixed crash in DeployAppRecipe.exe tool.

### Developer Community

* [Incorrect assembly generated with /O2, /fp:fast, and /arch:avx](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Incorrect-assembly-generated-with-O2-/10607330)
* [Internal Compiler Error when upgrading to 17.10.1 targeting ARM64](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Internal-Compiler-Error-when-upgrading-t/10690709)
* [With 17.11 preview 2.1, the compiler generates incorrect codegen on x86 with a snippet of code taken from the STL's vectorized code for std::min.](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/With-LKG17-wave-0-the-vectorized-std::m/10703415)
* [VS 17.10 bad code generation with /O2 /arch:AVX2](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/VS-1710-bad-code-generation-with-O2--/10707902)
* [Scaling of Diagnostics tools is wrong](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Scaling-of-Diagnostics-tools-is-wrong/10614845)

### Security advisories addressed

## [**CVE-2024-35272**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-35272) SQL Server Native Client OLE DB Provider Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
